notes.title: Early Access Launch Date, Pricing and GDEX Plans
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Everyone![/p][p]
[/p][p]I'm happy to announce that I finally have a release date for SIS and BRO's early access debut! The first early access build of [i]SIS and BRO The Cyborg Siblings[/i] will launch on [b][u]September 4th 2025. [/u][/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]Here's an overview of what you can expect from this initial build and how I'll release subsequent updates up until the full release launch. The build launching on September 4th will contain the already released demo portion of the game as well as a new storyline revolving around SIS and DOC. Each major content update after this will contain additional storylines that will eventually all come together into one overarching story. There will also be minor updates for bug fixes and various tweaks based on player feedback. [b]Everything presented is subject to change![/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]The game will be priced at [b]$5 USD [/b]with a [b]20% off launch discount available for the first two weeks. [/b]This one time purchase gives you full access to all early access updates as well as the full release. This price will not change after the early access period ends.[/p][p]
[/p][p]This release also coincides with the [b]GDEX 2025 convention! [/b]The convention runs from September 4th to September 7th at the Greater Columbus Convention Center.[b] [/b]I will have a table in the exhibition hall where an[b] [/b]exclusive playable demo will be showcased. Hope to see you there![/p][p]
[/p][p]I can't wait for you to see what I've been working on! Thank you and see y'all soon![/p][p]
[/p][p]A.J.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Plans
notes.notes:
Hi Everybody! I wanted to use this post to give you an overview of my current plans for the early access release of the game. Below you'll find an overview of my plans, which will also be listed on the games store page:

[i][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/i]
“This will allow me to release content for the game in increments and refine it with feedback from the community.”

[i][b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b][/i]
“The full release will most likely launch in 2026.”

[i][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b][/i]
“The full release will include the full storylines and alternate paths for both SIS and BRO along with the full soundtrack (which will be available for purchase at a later date).”

[i][b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b][/i]
“When the game launches in early access, only the main story path for SIS will be available. Additional content including all the storylines, choices and endings for both SIS and BRO's campaigns will be added through updates when they are ready. All content is subject to change before the game leaves early access.”

[i][b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b][/i]
“Price will not change when the game leaves early access”

[i][b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b][/i]
“Players can leave feedback and comments using the Steam Community message boards. A Discord server may be set up at a later date.”

notes.title: Change of Plans
notes.notes:
Hey all! It’s your ol’ pal A.J. again.

Just wanted to give y’all an update on the status of the game. To get right to the point, [b]I’ve decided to postpone the early access launch to a later date than my original plan of this year’s Visual Novel Fest.[/b] I feel that I need more development time to bring the game to a state that I feel comfortable releasing to the public. The early access launch I described in my previous post will now be scheduled for later this summer. The exact launch date will be announced at a later time.

notes.title: Updated Demo and Release Window
notes.notes:
Hi ho everyone!

This is A.J. speaking! 

For those who don't know, I'm the solo developer of SIS and BRO: The Cyborg Siblings. I wanted to start this post by thanking everyone who has taken the time to check out my little game, whether it was here on Steam or in person at GDEX, TORG or Corgscon! Your feedback and support means the world to me!

Now then, on to the news!

First off, I have updated the demo based on my observations from playtesting and feedback I received. I'll most likely update the demo more in the future as development progresses but its core structure will remain. 

Secondly, you're all probably curious about when the game will actually release. Luckily, I have a general plan ironed out. [b]I'm currently shooting for an EARLY ACCESS release in early March 2025, just in time for the Steam Visual Novel Fest![/b] The content I'm planning on releasing for this date will include the entire SIS portion of the story. My goal with this approach to release is to provide a more fleshed out version of the game while still leaving things open for feedback to ensure a more polished full release at a later date. The complete version will feature both SIS and BRO's campaigns.

That's all I have to report for now. Keep an eye out for more updates as we get closer to next March!
